title.narrative: Learning and Teaching in Crisis-Affected Contexts, and Education Systems Recovery

description.narrative: During the next biennium, we propose to strengthen education system preparedness and recovery capacities in crisis-affected contexts across Cameroon, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and the Central African Republic (CAR). This will involve assessing the impact of conflicts and displacement on education delivery, reinforcing the resilience of learning systems, and ensuring continuity of quality teaching and learning for crisis-affected populations — particularly internally displaced persons (IDPs), refugees, out-of-school children and youth, and host communities. The focus will be on developing crisis-sensitive education planning, strengthening teacher management and support mechanisms in emergency settings, and integrating social cohesion and peacebuilding into curriculum and pedagogical practices.
